ESSENCE: [0] Speech becomes the offering: the word crying victory at the threshold is itself to become bliss-giving; having Maheśa as protector is to become being protected.

paragraphs.text: Your own speech can become the gift you give. Stand at His door and cry out Victory, victory to the Lord who is greater than all — and let that very word turn into something that gives bliss. If you have the Great Lord as your protector, then you get to be someone who is protected.
